notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.content: [h1][b]Patch Notes - Demo Update[/b][/h1][p]This update addresses several smaller issues reported since the demo launch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Minor visual and interaction bugs resolved[/p][/*][*][p]Small gameplay inconsistencies corrected[/p][/*][*][p]General stability improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Development is also ongoing on a major rework of the movement system, which will be the focus of the next significant update.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has played the demo and shared feedback - your reviews are very helpful as the game continues to improve.[/p]

notes.title: STEAM DEMO
notes.content: [h2]Zomb Zerro 999 – Demo Launches August 25[/h2][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that the demo for [b]Zomb Zerro 999[/b] will be available on August 25 - right here on Steam![/p][p][/p][p][b]Explore. Investigate. Survive.[/b][/p][p]In this story-driven VR horror experience, you’ll step into the boots of Sam Keller, a technician trapped deep inside a secret mountain facility where a failed experiment - and something far older - now stirs.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo offers a first glimpse into the dark world of Zomb Zerro 999, featuring:[/p][list][*][p]    Atmospheric exploration[/p][/*][*][p]    Environmental storytelling[/p][/*][*][p]    Puzzle-solving and early narrative beats[/p][/*][*][p]    A hint of the danger to come...[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Add the game to your wishlist to be notified as soon as the demo goes live.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support - and stay tuned for more updates as we approach launch.[/p][p]- Marcus[/p][p]Apex Aurora Games[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280332/cb641c76110bff49f6004a1510b92fb89112ba7c.png"][/img][/p]
